title: What's New: Excel Reports for Finance and Sales (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Excel report limitations and data aggregation
Sales reports - receivables and top customers
Copilot in Excel demo - outlier detection

features.name: Trial balance Excel report
features.description: Excel report showing trial balance data with dimensions and account categories as slicers for easy filtering. Includes both local currency and additional reporting currency versions. Laid out as a printable report template with raw data for pivot tables and charting.
features.status_evidence_quote: they are marked with preview for now because we might have some design changes we want to do but they're fully functional
caveats: Aggregated at account and period level without daily totals
Data limited to approximately 100,000 rows for performance

features.name: Accounts receivable aging report
features.description: Excel report showing customer aging with filtering by due date, period length and count. Offers multiple views by period, local currency, functional currency, and breakdown by currency. Includes detail per customer per period with dimensional breakdown.
features.status_evidence_quote: they are marked with preview for now because we might have some design changes we want to do but they're fully functional
caveats: Aggregated data, not detailed customer transaction level
Finer granularity available in future releases

features.name: Customer top list report
features.description: Simple Excel report showing top customers by sales or balance with included chart. Allows customization of top count (e.g. top 100 instead of just top 10) and filtering.
features.status_evidence_quote: they are marked with preview for now because we might have some design changes we want to do but they're fully functional

features.name: Accounts payable aging report
features.description: Excel report for vendor aging showing payable aging by due date with period length and count filtering. Includes ability to skip vendors with zero balance. Multiple worksheets show printable format and aggregated data views.
features.status_evidence_quote: they are marked with preview for now because we might have some design changes we want to do but they're fully functional
caveats: Aggregated data per vendor per period
Detailed transaction level data coming in future releases

features.name: Copilot in Excel - data analysis
features.description: Copilot integration with Excel reports for deeper data analysis. Allows users to ask questions about data, identify patterns and insights. Features outlier detection using machine learning to identify suspicious patterns in datasets.
features.status_evidence_quote: right now in preview as of April or March 2024 U there's also new things coming in Excel
caveats: Requires larger datasets beyond demo data to function effectively
Copilot suggestions require human verification and analysis

features.name: Open in Excel functionality
features.description: Capability to open Business Central data directly in Excel for analysis, complementing the new Excel reports functionality.
